# Rule: WEAK export loss demoted by a binding rule

_Canonical rule slug:_ `export-loss-weak-binding-demoted`. [← back to all rules](index.md)

> WEAK inline, template, or undeclared exports that the new library no longer exports are reclassified to a risk by a binding-scoped policy rule.
